overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: contacts between one member and the chair only added a candidate to the agenda, which is administrative and not deliberation, and no quorum deliberated outside the meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Select Board deliberated outside a noticed meeting before its August 11, 2015 vote to fill a Board of Assessors vacancy.
allegations.key_passage: Here, there is no evidence that a quorum of the Board discussed its decision to appoint Mr. Ketron prior to its August 11, 2015 meeting.
